text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I have been bested.
Well done, Ryan. As expected of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Her obsession with conquering the Classics
slightly surpassed even my own will……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot keep hanging my head like this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I feel ashamed. I scold myself.
And yet, I will move forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us proceed at once, Trainer.
—To discuss retraining my regimen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for fighting with everything you had,
McQueen."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm certain that you...
are only going to keep getting stronger from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I won't lose next time either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once the Kikuka Sho is over,
there's very little left of this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And once the new year arrives, it won't be long...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This is the race I have made my ultimate goal.
—I shall surely show you the culmination of everything I am."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen burned with fighting spirit.
Her eyes gazed earnestly toward the future.
